salesforce-h360.description: Salesforce Headless 360 MCP server. Three tools: discover(query) - semantic search across Salesforce APIs to find available operations; describe(id) - full specification for a discovered operation or object; dispatch(method, url, queryParams, body) - execute any Salesforce REST API call (SOQL queries, sObject CRUD, UI API, Tooling API). Supports read and guided create/update on Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Leads, and activities.
